changelog: Phase E (P14-P16): Single-school architecture, first-run setup script, and campus branches. Implemented interactive CLI setup script (npm run setup) with schema verification, bcrypt cost 12 hashing, initial tuition fee head, and schema_migrations tracking. Streamlined UI into single-school mode: Owner role is preserved with elevated full Admin access, school switcher and multi-school comparisons removed, and school mutations restricted to single-school updates. Added branches table and branch_id on classes, complete with server-side validation against orphaned class deletions, branch assignment in ClassFormModal, and branch filters in ClassManagementPage and StudentManagementPage.
